originalTitle: Duncan Scott shines for Scotland again with 200m individual medley gold
summary: Duncan Scott added to his trophy cabinet with gold for Scotland in the men’s 200m individual medley at the Commonwealth Games
content: There are generals from banana republics with fewer medals on their chests than Duncan Scott. And when the pressure was highest at a home Commonwealth Games, the most decorated Scottish athlete of all time delivered again. On paper it looked like a stacked men’s 200m individual medley, with world and Olympic champions, including New Zealander Lewis Clareburt and England’s Tom Dean, lurking with intent. But Scott had other ideas. After a strong butterfly, the 29-year-old applied the squeeze on the backstroke and breaststroke and then delivered the coup de grace on the freestyle to take gold in 1min 56.38sec, nearly half a second clear of Clareburt, who took silver, with Dean claiming bronze. To make Scott’s victory even sweeter, he also broke the Commonwealth record. No wonder he lifted his arms up in the air and started to pound his chest like a silverback after leaving the pool. “I was a wee bit nervous before that,” he said. “Being one of the senior members of the team, the onus is kind of me. Those boys made it tough.” Scott has now won eight Olympic medals, 10 world medals and 14 at the Commonwealth Games. The way he is swimming, he is going to need a bigger medal cabinet by the end of next week. But this is just the start of a gruelling process. At the 2018 Commonwealth Games on the Gold Coast, he swam 11 races in five days and won six medals. In Birmingham in 2022 it was 12 in five and he won six more. So when asked how he would celebrate this latest gold, he said he did not know. “Probably an early night,” he eventually replied. Meanwhile, Dean was happy with his individual bronze, knowing that better chances of winning gold lie ahead. “I have raced Duncan my whole adult career,” he said. “To stand next to him, to walk out with him in front of his crowd, it was something I will never forget. I am fortunate to call him a training partner as well as a friend.” Another star of these Games, Adam Ramsay-Peaty had to work to win his 100m breaststroke semi-final ahead of Jersey’s teenage sensation Filip Nowacki. Ramsay-Peaty was through halfway in a lightning quick 27.40sec but the 18-year-old Nowacki came back at him in the second half. But it was not quite enough as Ramsay-Peaty held on to win by less than half a second in 59.19. Australia’s Sam Williamson finished fastest in the other semi-final in 59.27. Asked about his thoughts on Saturday’s final, Ramsay-Peaty smiled. “I’m not going to shy away from the fact that I want to win,” Ramsay-Peaty replied. “I’m still going to be a scrapper.” But Nowacki, who is awaiting his A-Level results in maths, economics and physics, believes he can spring a surprise. “To race arguably the greatest breaststroker of all time is very special,” he said. “Can I beat him? I’m going to say yes. My training’s been progressing really well, so I’m going to give it my best and we’ll see who gets their hand on the wall first.” Elsewhere, it was a great night for Australia, who won four golds. It started on the first race of the night, as Lani Pallister pushed clear in the last 100m to beat New Zealander Erika Fairweather in the 400m freestyle in 3:59.56, with another Australian Hannah Fredericks taking bronze. Just 44 minutes later, Fredericks was back in the pool and had the energy to launch a late surge to win the 200m backstroke ahead of Scotland’s Katie Shanahan in a thriller. Two more golds followed as Australia then won the women’s and men’s 4x100m freestyle relays, with England taking silver in both races.
chineseTitle: 邓肯·斯科特再次代表苏格兰夺得200米个人混合泳金牌
chineseSummary: 邓肯·斯科特 (Duncan Scott) 在英联邦运动会男子 200 米个人混合泳比赛中为苏格兰队夺得金牌，为他的奖杯柜增添了一枚金牌
chineseContent: 有些来自香蕉共和国的将军胸前佩戴的奖章比邓肯·斯科特还要少。当主场英联邦运动会压力最大时，这位有史以来获奖最多的苏格兰运动员再次表现出色。从纸面上看，这看起来像是一场男子200米个人混合泳，世界冠军和奥运会冠军，包括新西兰选手刘易斯·克莱尔伯特和英格兰选手汤姆·迪恩，都在蓄意潜伏。但斯科特有其他想法。在完成了一次强有力的蝶泳之后，这位29岁的选手在仰泳和蛙泳上运用了挤压技术，然后在自由泳上取得了致命一击，以1分56.38秒的成绩夺得金牌，比获得银牌的克莱尔伯特快了近半秒，迪恩获得了铜牌。为了让斯科特的胜利更加甜蜜，他还打破了英联邦纪录。难怪他离开泳池后，就举起双臂，像银背大猩猩一样捶胸顿足。 “在那之前我有点紧张，”他说。 “作为团队中的资深成员之一，我有责任。那些男孩让事情变得艰难。”斯科特目前已赢得 8 枚奥运会奖牌、10 枚世界奖牌和 14 枚英联邦运动会奖牌。按照他游泳的方式，到下周末他将需要一个更大的奖牌柜。但这只是一个艰苦过程的开始。在黄金海岸举行的 2018 年英联邦运动会上，他在 5 天内参加了 11 场比赛并赢得了 6 枚奖牌。 2022 年在伯明翰，五场比赛中他赢得了 12 场，他又赢得了六场胜利。因此，当被问及他将如何庆祝这枚最新金牌时，他说他不知道。 “可能是一个很早的夜晚，”他最终回答道。与此同时，迪恩对自己的个人铜牌感到满意，因为他知道赢得金牌的机会更大。 “我的整个成年职业生涯都在与邓肯比赛，”他说。 “站在他旁边，在人群面前和他一起走出去，真是太棒了。
